0022600206.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-3) visit the Toronto Raptors (5-4) on the road, where they are 4-0, though they are 2-3 at home and have lost three straight. Memphis sits 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 7th in the West, while Toronto is 4th in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 6th in the East, riding a one-game winning streak. Memphis will be without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), with Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and Memphis lost both games against Toronto in 2025-26, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
